programme.desc: Forty-year-old and single again, Bridget Jones focuses on work. But after meeting Jack, a dashing American, Bridget is surprised by a... pregnancy! The problem is that she is only 50% sure about the identity of the baby's father...

programme.title: Erin Brockovich
programme.desc: Erin Brockovich is a single, unemployed mother, and luck has not been smiling on her. With no alternative, she forces the lawyer who was unable to defend her in a court case to give her a job. The involvement proves to be historic. Oscar®-winning film in 2001.

programme.title: Mary J. Blige, True Love
programme.desc: Mary J. Blige's Real Love follows 18-year-old Kendra as she attends a historically black university (HBCU) in North Carolina. Kendra is determined to focus on her studies while balancing academic work and maintaining a professional relationship.

programme.title: Conan the destroyer
programme.desc: Queen Taramis entrusts Conan with a very dangerous mission: to accompany Princess Jehnna on a long journey for which she was born predestined. Their objective is to recover a jewel that is in the possession of a powerful sorcerer. If he succeeds, the queen promises that she will help him recover Valeria, his great love. But the monarch's intentions are very different since with the jewel she wants to bring an ancient god back to life.

programme.title: The flight
programme.desc: Commander Whip Whitaker is forced to make an emergency landing of the aircraft he is piloting, thereby saving many lives. He is considered a hero, until the subsequent investigation reveals that he had used narcotics the night before the incident. The pilot faces a trial in which he must put his career and his own life in order.

programme.title: Hitman
programme.desc: Agent 47 has been genetically engineered to become an effective and lethal hitman, working under instructions from a mysterious group known as 'The Organization'. However, when he finds himself involved in a political conspiracy that is beyond his understanding, he will turn against what he has known until now to try to find out who has set him up. While Interpol and the Russian army search for him throughout Europe, the murderer will have to face two new elements in his life: conscience and love.

programme.title: Demolition
programme.desc: A successful executive struggles to understand his emotional disconnection after the sudden and tragic death of his wife in a car accident. Despite his father-in-law's pressure to recover, Davis remains bewildered and reflects this by compulsively disassembling increasingly conspicuous objects around him.

programme.title: The client
programme.desc: Mark Sway is an eleven-year-old boy who witnesses the death of a mafia lawyer. Before dying, he confesses some very important information to him. But, fearing retaliation, Mark doesn't dare tell the FBI. The FBI pressures Mark to reveal the lawyer's last words, but he, aware that the mafia is watching him, decides to hire a lawyer to protect him. Adaptation of the best seller of the same name by John Grisham, directed by Joel Schumacher (''A Day of Fury'', ''Batman Forever''). Its plot starting point is vaguely reminiscent of that of ''Sole Witness'', although the Mormon community that surrounded Harrison Ford in Peter Weir's film is replaced here by a single character: that of a devoted lawyer. For this reason, the true core of the film, despite being a thriller, is not the judicial plot, but the relationship established between the boy, played by Brad Renfro (chosen from 5,000 candidates), and his lawyer, a role entrusted to Susan Sarandon, for which she was nominated for an Oscar for best actress. Tommy Lee Jones gave life to the third party, in the shoes of an ambitious prosecutor.

programme.title: Deuda de sangre
programme.desc: When Terry McCaleb is called to a crime scene where his partners Detective Waller and Arrango are waiting for him, he can't even imagine how events will unfold. Victims five and six of the latest series of murders await him, and on a wall is written in blood "McCaleb, fuck me if you can" and a number code. As Terry tries to avoid giving answers to the reporters, he encounters one with blood on his shoes. He will chase him but when he almost catches him, he suffers a heart attack and falls to the ground. The suspect approaches and looks at him and Terry shoots him in the fog he sees without knowing if he has really wounded him. 2 years later, Terry is going to have some tests after his heart transplant. His doctor, Dr. Fox, gives him the all-clear before the retired agent goes to his ship, where he meets Graciella Rivers. The woman wants to hire him to investigate the disappearance of her nephew: Raymond. He also tells him that the heart that Terry has received is from Graciella's own sister. The next day the retired agent will meet with his former colleagues, who show him a security tape of a small store where there has been a murder. Even though it is prohibited, Terry will go there to ask questions to begin his investigation until he comes to the conclusion that the store robbery and murder has to do with another that occurred recently. As the investigation continues, Terry's stress increases, causing his recent transplant to hurt more and more. But the murders are there and the former agent is convinced that he will be able to find a relationship between them all that will bring to light the culprit. This Clint Eastwood film exists in the same universe as "The Innocent." But despite his most famous roles playing Dirty Harry and other cops, this FBI agent is the last of Clint's incarnations as a detective.

programme.title: The agent
programme.desc: In the year 2030, the world is in a permanent state of economic recession and faces serious environmental problems as a result of global warming. All those citizens who are unproductive are exiled to a colony.

programme.title: S.W.A.T.: Harrelson's Men
programme.desc: Jim Street, former member of the S.W.A.T, was expelled from the team along with his partner Brian Gamble, due to a controversial decision he made in a robbery with hostages case. For Street, his work is his life and he is looking for the opportunity to wear the uniform again. That opportunity comes when Dan "Hondo" Harrelson, the team's commander, must recruit and train five high-level police officers for a new special weapons and tactics team. After a few hard weeks of training, the team goes into action: a drug lord offers a large sum of money to whoever frees him from police control. The S.W.A.T. team He must guard the enemy while being chased by a band of mercenaries. Film version of the famous 70's television series "Harrelson's Men".

programme.title: The law of the street
programme.desc: A 14-year-old boy joins a gang in Washington, but he is determined that his 10-year-old brother will not follow in his footsteps. Everything indicates that this will be his destiny, until he meets a war veteran.

programme.title: natural born killers
programme.desc: Mickey and Mallory are two young people who, in love and maddened, murder the girl's father in cold blood and begin a flight. The host of a sensational program decides to take advantage of the fascination that his personality exerts on the public to turn the murderers into television heroes.

programme.title: 22 Balas
programme.desc: A former member of the mafia who has been retired for three years, living a peaceful life dedicated to his wife and children, is attacked one morning by some men and left for dead after receiving 22 bullets. However, after miraculously surviving, he begins searching for Tony Zacchia, the only man capable of daring to kill him. Tony has made only one mistake: failing in his attempt...

programme.title: 10 minutes less
programme.desc: Frank is a criminal who, together with his companions, tries to rob a bank. However, the police end up being alerted and while trying to flee, a mysterious assailant hits Frank on the head, causing him to lose part of his memory. Rex, the leader of the gang, awaits answers about the failed robbery, while Frank will try to do everything possible to recover the 10 minutes that have disappeared from his memory and find the person responsible for his fall from grace.

programme.title: Terminator Salvation
programme.desc: Year 2018. Judgment Day has passed and has devastated modern civilization. An army of Terminators roams the Earth to capture and kill all those humans who have survived. The few that remain have organized themselves and hide in bunkers creating what they call "The Resistance" to combat the robots when they have the chance even though they are outnumbered. The Terminators are controlled by Skynet, an artificial intelligence network that was created 14 years earlier by the government, but which turned against them, and which wants to cause nuclear annihilation. Only one man can stop it, John Connor. He has been taught his entire life for this moment by his mother, Sarah Connor, who already knew what was going to happen, but something that was not in her plans makes him doubt what he has known so far. The appearance of Marcus Wright, a stranger who comes from the past and whose last memory is of being on death row, and who also insists on having been with Kyle Reese, John's father. What John does not know is that Marcus, in 2003, had donated his organs and brain to the Cyberdyne company before being executed, and that with this they created a special Terminator who was left with his heart and biological brain. John must decide whether to trust Marcus as the Resistance prepares its final attack on the Terminators, which will take place at Skynet's base of operations.

programme.title: Platoon
programme.desc: Filmed entirely in the Philippines, "Platoon" tells us about the year a young university student named Chris spends in a regiment, who decides to volunteer in the Vietnam War. First part of a trilogy directed and written by Oliver Stone about the Vietnam War (followed by Born on the Fourth of July and Between Heaven and Earth). The protagonist of this story is a young Charlie Sheen, accompanied by a cast among which we highlight Willem Dafoe, Tom Berenger or some at that time still unknown Forest Whitaker or Johnny Depp. "Platoon" was the first film about Vietnam written and directed by a veteran of that war. Oliver Stone created this masterpiece taken from the experiences that he himself lived on the battlefield in his year as a soldier, filming almost a documentary where he tells us in first person through a character named Chris all his experiences in Vietnam. We are thus witnessing one of the most precise and realistic war films that recount this conflict with excellent direction, a script and impeccable editing. As for the exteriors, they are very well detailed and this perfection makes the viewer quickly immerse themselves in the war atmosphere that surrounds everything without rest. Definitely, a spectacular film that shows what until then Hollywood always tried to hide and the best way to get closer to what those days in Vietnam really were. Classic of the eighties and universal cinema.

programme.title: Zooloco
programme.desc: The animals at Franklin Park Zoo adore their kind keeper, Griffin Keyes. When Griffin realizes that he is more comfortable with a lion than a lady, he decides that the only way to get a girl to share his life is to leave the zoo and look for a more glamorous job.

programme.title: Duplicity
programme.desc: MI6 agent Ray Koval (Clive Owen) is in Dubai when he meets Claire Stenwick (Julia Roberts). After groping her a little, he manages to win her over and they spend the night together, without knowing that Claire is part of the CIA. When Ray wakes up the next day, the woman has disappeared with several compromised documents. For years, Ray searches for her, leaves his job at MI6 and gets a new one in the espionage department of a large multinational. In his third week of work he meets Claire again. Now they both work as spies for large companies and Claire is not willing to allow anyone to come and destroy the professional future she has been building for just over a year. The two spies will use all kinds of tricks to keep their positions, but they will also have to fight against the great attraction they feel for each other so as not to succumb to the other person's deceptions. In this film, actor Clive Owen plays MI6 spy Ray Koval. Owen began his career in television, working mainly on not very well-known series. Currently, although he still makes some stellar appearances on television, he is one of the best-known faces on the big screen. He has worked in films such as 'The Bourne Affair', 'King Arthur' and 'Closer' where he shares the bill for the first time with actress Julia Roberts. In 'Duplicity', Roberts plays Claire Stenwick, a retired CIA agent. The acclaimed actress began her career in 1987, in the series 'The History of Crime'. After that she worked in several films until she gained fame through 'Pretty Woman' and her starring role alongside actor Richard Gere. From there her career took off and her charming smile made her 'America's Sweetheart'. He played several leading roles in romantic comedies but he has always tried to combine it with more serious roles such as those he played in 'Stay by me' or 'Erin Brockovich'.

programme.title: Son of a Gun
programme.desc: Young JR is accused and imprisoned for a minor crime. When he enters prison he discovers the harshness of life in prison, but he will soon become the protégé of Brendan Lynch, one of the most dangerous prisoners in Australia. However, that protection will have a price and Lynch, along with his team, will have plans for JR when he is released from prison: help them with their escape plan.

programme.title: The jury
programme.desc: A young New Orleans widow files a civil lawsuit against a powerful corporate consortium whom she blames for her husband's death. Thus, a multimillion-dollar case is launched. Judicial thriller based on a novel by John Grisham, a best-selling writer who is well versed in all the ins and outs of United States law.

programme.title: Django Unchained
programme.desc: Texas. Two years before the American Civil War breaks out. King Schultz is a German bounty hunter who is tracking murderers to collect for their heads, and he promises the black slave Django to set him free on the condition that he helps him catch them. Django accepts, since his greatest wish is to go rescue his wife Broomhilda, a slave who is on the plantation of landowner Calvin Candie. This film, written and directed by Quentin Tarantino, is a western film with references to the spaghetti western genre; genre through which I wanted to portray a story about slavery like this one. Tarantino is a renowned American director, producer and screenwriter whose films are characterized by addressing non-linear stories, violence, Grindhouse influences, kung fu and spaghetti westerns. Starring Jamie Foxx ('Bait', 'Collateral'), Christoph Waltz ('Inglourious Basterds', 'Dorian'), Leonardo DiCaprio ('Titanic', 'The Great Gatsby') and Samuel L. Jackson ('S.W.A.T.', 'Star Wars'); The film is a mix of good dialogue, rhythm, irony, and an impeccable soundtrack that allows it to capture the viewer's attention at all times.

programme.title: Hitman
programme.desc: Agent 47 has been genetically engineered to become an effective and lethal hitman, working under instructions from a mysterious group known as 'The Organization'. However, when he finds himself involved in a political conspiracy that is beyond his understanding, he will turn against what he has known until now to try to find out who has set him up. While Interpol and the Russian army search for him throughout Europe, the murderer will have to face two new elements in his life: conscience and love.

programme.title: Hitman. Agent 47
programme.desc: Based on the famous video game, Hitman is an elite assassin who has been genetically modified to become a perfect killing machine. Identified only by a barcode that he has tattooed, his target is a corporation that aims to reveal his past and create assassins more powerful than him.

programme.title: Spider-Man: Homecoming
programme.desc: Peter Parker is a young man who studies in high school and lives with his Aunt May. But in addition to all the problems that a teenager his age can have, Peter's life hides something totally unusual, and that is that he combines his ordinary teenage life with the identity of the famous superhero Spider-Man. After having fought alongside the Avengers to save New York City, Peter returns to his Aunt May's house, where he will try to resume his routine while being trained by his mentor Tony Stark to become an Avenger and fight crime. The adaptation will not be easy and soon a new villain known as The Vulture will burst onto the scene, whom Spider-Man will have to defeat.

programme.title: Spider-Man: Far From Home
programme.desc: When they investigate a cyclone that has devastated a Mexican town, Nick Furia and Maria Hill are surprised by an unknown superhero. In New York, Peter Parker tries to adapt to life after 'The Gap' and the disappearance of his mentor.

programme.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
programme.desc: With Spider-Man's identity revealed, Peter turns to Doctor Strange for help. Something goes wrong and the multiverse becomes the biggest threat to the world. Now Peter must discover what it really means to be Spider-Man.

programme.title: Godzilla
programme.desc: Godzilla is the remake of a 1954 Japanese film called Goiira. In this remake, the film focuses heavily on the people affected by the case, not just the beast. Dr. Nick Tatopoulos is sent to Panama with a group of soldiers to investigate the causes of the destruction of a Japanese ship in the Pacific. There he finds remains of the skin of an animal unknown in the world of science and they believe that they are a mutation resulting from nuclear tests& The giant lizard, whose appearance in this American remake is far from the original Japanese appearance, crosses the ocean and heads to New York, there, in addition to frightening society and causing serious damage, it is attacked by the military forces with missiles from helicopters among other methods, but the beast seems implacable. The effects necessary to give the animal realism cost around 50 million dollars. The film had a total cost of 120 million dollars. Nick, thanks to a blood sample that he managed to take from the animal, discovers that it is a hermaphrodite that collects food for himself and his offspring& This complicates things& The event is followed worldwide and Audrey Timmonds, ex-wife of scientist Nick, steals a video tape from Panama to benefit her journalistic career, which at the same time will bring serious problems for Nick. This film is just one of the many works that came from the original Japanese idea, whose mark is present in video games, comics or animated series.

programme.title: what a couple of cops
programme.desc: Two police officers are looking for a very expensive baseball card from 1952. They must rescue a Mexican supermodel and put an end to a drug organization.

programme.title: Crank: High voltage
programme.desc: Hitman Chelios faces off against a Chinese gangster who has stolen his virtually indestructible heart and replaced it with a sophisticated battery-powered device that requires frequent bursts of electricity to continue functioning.

programme.title: Demolition
programme.desc: A successful executive struggles to understand his emotional disconnection after the sudden and tragic death of his wife in a car accident. Despite his father-in-law's pressure to recover, Davis remains bewildered and reflects this by compulsively disassembling increasingly conspicuous objects around him.

programme.title: A doctor in the countryside
programme.desc: After 30 years working as the only doctor in a small village in a rural area of ​​southern France, Jean-Pierre falls ill. Health problems remove the doctor who attended, cured and cared for his neighbors from the profession 365 days a year and at any time. That is why it is necessary for another person to move in to replace him during sick leave. At that moment, Nathalie, a young doctor who has just finished her residency and who also has extensive experience as a nurse, arrives in the village. She will be in charge of helping Pierre with his work when he can't, but it will be a professional challenge because she has never worked in a medical office in a small town. In this way, it will also be complicated for Jean-Pierre because for him his work is the most important thing, so he will have to learn to deal with his new partner.

programme.title: Better... impossible
programme.desc: Melvin Udall is a novelist with obsessive-compulsive disorder that, among other things, causes him to walk down the street without stepping on sidewalk lines or to use new cutlery every time he eats. But Melvin is also proud of his ability to offend and irritate others, especially his neighbor Simon Nye, a homosexual artist whom the writer always attacks with his viperous tongue. Melvin has breakfast every day in a cafeteria and there is only one waitress who can put up with him, Carol, a single mother struggling to raise her asthmatic son. The fate of these characters will be intertwined because of a dog and a trip.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels: The Edge
programme.desc: Second part of Charlie's Angels. Dylan, Natalie and Alex are sent by their boss on a new mission: locate a group of rings that have been stolen from the Department of Justice. This device allows its owner to know the list of people who are in the FBI's Witness Protection Program. When the first witnesses begin to appear dead, the Angels will have to use all their ingenuity to solve the case. An exceptional cameo can be seen in this film: one of the original Angels, Jaclyn Smith.

programme.title: Spider-Man: a new universe
programme.desc: After being bitten by a spider and acquiring superpowers, teenager Miles Morales dedicates himself to leading a double life in which he combines his high school routine with patrolling the city and chasing villains.

programme.title: Spider-Man: Crossing the Multiverse
programme.desc: Traveling through the multiverse, Miles Morales meets a new team of Spider-Man, made up of heroes from different dimensions. But when the heroes disagree over how to confront a new threat, Miles finds himself at a crossroads.

programme.title: The Amazing Spider-Man
programme.desc: Peter Parker was abandoned by his parents when he was still a child, and was raised by his Uncle Ben and Aunt May. Somewhat marginalized at school, Peter wants to know his past and find out who he is, but there he meets his first love, Gwen Stacy. When Peter discovers a briefcase that belonged to his father, he begins a quest to learn how his parents disappeared, something that will take him to Oscorp and the laboratory of his father's former partner, Dr. Connor, where he is bitten by an experimentally modified spider that gives him incredible powers. The murder of his uncle by a thief will make him seek revenge, catching the criminals he finds in his path, so he realizes that his destiny is to help people. But Dr. Connor, in turn, is forced to test his own experiment (a lizard serum that regenerates body limbs) on himself after his dismissal, which turns him into The Lizard. This will spread panic among the citizens, and Peter will be forced to use his powers. It is the first film of a cinematographic reboot of this character, since due to script problems Sony had canceled the fourth installment of Spider-Man, opting for this reboot. Marc Webb is in charge of directing the film, and he specializes in the world of music videos, in which groups such as Green Day, My Chemical Romance, Evanescence, Maroon 5 and Fergie have featured him. His only films are (500) Days Together and the first and second installment of this new Spider-Man saga. Andrew Garfield plays Peter Parker. He began in theater and acted in Leones por Corderos and the television film Boy A, which gave him recognition; just like his performance in The Social Network. Emma Stone plays Gwen Stacy, and participated in films such as Campus Bunny, Ghosts of My Ex-Girlfriends, Crazy, Stupid, Love or Entitled to Friction. His role in Easy A earned him a Golden Globe nomination.

programme.title: The Amazing Spider-Man 2: El poder de Electro
programme.desc: Peter Parker leads a very busy life: he has to save the city from bad guys and also continue with his university life to take care of Gwen, although from a distance. Things get complicated when the villain Electro appears with a thirst for revenge. However, it won't be the only thing Peter has to face, as the return of an old friend, Harry Osborn, brings new clues about his past.

programme.title: Life at stake
programme.desc: The film delves into the story of Sean Porter, Camp Kilpatrick juvenile detention camp probation officer and retired player, and his partner, Officer Malcolm Moore, who turned a group of dangerous juvenile delinquents into the Camp Kilpatrick Mustangs football team, having a fantastic season in 1990 and reaching the regional championship final against the Montclair Prep High School team. Porter will teach the boys to go against gang rivalries and bitter hatreds between peers, and both he and the young men will learn difficult lessons about life while the boys also acquire a sense of responsibility and self-respect.

programme.title: AI Decoded
programme.desc: AI Decoded explores the growing backlash against artificial intelligence. As fears of job losses spread through the tech industry and protests against AI data centres gather momentum, we ask whether the promises of an AI-powered future are starting to unravel. Plus, could advanced AI one day become conscious, and if it does, what responsibilities would we have towards it? Presenter Marc Cieslak is joined by digital rights activist Cory Doctorow, AI entrepreneur Priya Lakhani and academic Dr Ella Hafermalz to unpack the biggest questions facing AI today.

programme.title: Clive Myrie’s Caribbean Adventure
programme.desc: For 11 months of the year, the city of La Vega is well off the tourist track. But each February, it bursts into life. Over the course of four weekends, it’s loud, hot and colourful as visitors from all over the world arrive to join in the famous street carnivals. Clive is in the party mood and throws himself into the fun. He stocks up on local sweet treats, meets talented mask makers and prepares outrageous costumes before joining the parade in full costume.

programme.title: Pacar Dari Langit
programme.desc: Karena ayahnya sakit. Mega terpaksa pulang ke kampung halaman dan jatuh cinta kepada alien bernama Zen. yang berjanji akan selalu menjaganya.

programme.title: Harta Karun Nenek Bajak
programme.desc: Putri mempunyai kekasih yang terlibat hutang bernama Draco. Saat sedang terdesak dia teringat bahwa dia memiliki kenalan bernama Mira yang memiliki nenek kaya raya bernama Nenek Bajak di kampungnya. Putri menipu Nenek Bajak.

programme.title: Toko Kr.Amat Kamera Masa Lalu
programme.desc: Jack, seorang detektif junior ditugaskan menyelidiki kasus pencurian. Ketika menuju lokasi Jack lupa membawa kamera, terpaksa ia mencari kamera hingga berhenti di sebuah toko benda antik dan membeli kamera.

programme.title: Habibah's recitation of the Quran
programme.desc: Key keturunan Tionghoa yang kabur dari rumah dan menjalin hubungan dengan pria dari etnis yang berbeda. Ketika sang kekasih meninggalkannya dalam keadaan hamil, Key bertemu Handoko yang mengenalkannya pada cinta tanpa syarat.

programme.title: Kecantol Derek Cinta
programme.desc: Mona dan Ryan dipertemukan karena derek mobil, atau lebih tepatnya karena mobilnya diderek oleh Ryan karena melanggar peraturan parkir. Apa kisah mereka hanya sampai di sini?

programme.title: Pliss Gue Bukan Princess
programme.desc: Genta mengenalkan Alila, pacarnya, ke ibunya. Namun, Alila dianggap kurang feminin, sehingga ibu Genta memberi waktu agar Alila bisa berubah.

programme.title: Putri Salju Van Betawi
programme.desc: puteri adalah seorang gadis yang dibuang dan akan dibunuh oleh Ibu tirinya sendiri. Dia akhirnya ditemukan dan dibesarkan oleh seorang jawara betawi yang melatihnya menjadi seorang gadis pesilat handal.

programme.title: Pacar Dari Langit
programme.desc: Karena ayahnya sakit. Mega terpaksa pulang ke kampung halaman dan jatuh cinta kepada alien bernama Zen. yang berjanji akan selalu menjaganya.

programme.title: Kesengsem Tukang Sedot WC
programme.desc: Dika, seorang tukang sedot WC yang tampan, yang terlibat masalah dengan atasan barunya, anak perempuan pemilik perusahaan yang ditugaskan untuk menyelidiki dugaan penyelewengan dana perusahaan.

programme.title: Salon Madam : Rambut Api
programme.desc: Seorang wanita datang ke Salon Madam untuk mengecat rambutnya dan mempercantik penampilannya, tapi cantik itu luka, dan rambutnya bisa menjadi petaka membara jika tak digunakan dengan bijak.

programme.title: Cinta Lutung Kasarung
programme.desc: Rara yang culas kecewa ketika Sari terpilih sebagai pewaris utama Prabu. Rara bersekongkol dengan Indra tunangannya untuk menyingkirkan Sari dengan memberinya ramuan yang membuat kulitnya bersisik dan ia bersembunyi di hutan.

programme.title: Hijab Yang Tertukar
programme.desc: Kiara terjebak dalam situasi yang mengharuskan ia berpura-pura menjadi Anisa, seorang perempuan yang dijodohkan dengan Fachri. Saat Annisa asli datang, Fachri pun kesulitan untuk memilih antara Kiara atau Anisa.

programme.title: 7 Pusaka - Sabuk Penghilang Raga
programme.desc: Raga adalah seorang maling kelas teri yang bernasib sial. Saat dikejar para warga dan bersembunyi di dalam sebuah kali, tiba-tiba Raga menemukan sebuah koin gobang yang hanyut. Saat Raga menggenggam koin itu, ia menghilang.

programme.title: Cintaku Di Kejar Cicilan
programme.desc: Andre adalah pria tampan yang selalu bergaya dengan barang-barang mewah. Namun, semua itu dibeli Andre dengan berutang, akhirnya dia pun dikejar cicilan yang menumpuk.

programme.title: Perempuan Berkalung Perban
programme.desc: Perempuan Berkalung Perban bercerita tentang seorang perempuan yang mempunyai tanda lahir aneh di lehernya dan membuatnya dikejar-kejar oleh berbagai makhluk jahat. Itu sebabnya ia menutupi tanda lahirnya tersebut dengan perban.

programme.title: Terdampar Di Pulau Kosong
programme.desc: Tomi mengajak teman-teman sekelas liburan di sebuah pulau.Tomi ajak Hani jalan-jalan dengan speedboat. Ditengah laut speedboat hilang kendali. Tomi menyelamatkan diri sendiri dan Hani ditinggal terdampar di pulau tak berpenghuni.

programme.title: Ketemu Cinta Di Online Shop
programme.desc: Rayya adalah mahasiswa yang menekuni bisnis online. Dia mendapat saingan yaitu Pras, teman kampusnya yang juga punya bisnis toko online. Setelah kalah bersaing, Pras bekerja untuk Rayya, dan mereka saling jatuh cinta.

programme.title: Ketemu Cinta Di Online Shop
programme.desc: Rayya adalah mahasiswa yang menekuni bisnis online. Dia mendapat saingan yaitu Pras, teman kampusnya yang juga punya bisnis toko online. Setelah kalah bersaing, Pras bekerja untuk Rayya, dan mereka saling jatuh cinta.

programme.title: Whose Baby Is In Classroom?
programme.desc: Chen, seorang guru laki-laki di SMA khusus perempuan, terjebak dengan bayi yang bukan miliknya dan harus merawatnya. Murid-murid kelasnya membantu mengurus bayi itu sementara ia menggunakan pesonanya pada Li Ching.

programme.title: The Five Venoms
programme.desc: Sebuah film kung fu yang tak tertandingi dari sutradara film kung fu terbaik, Chang Cheh. Guru dari Klan Racun yang tengah sekarat mengirim murid terakhirnya dalam misi berbahaya untuk memburu lima prajurit.

programme.title: Return Of The Phoenix
programme.desc: Return Of The Phoenix adalah karya besar lain dari sutradara Li Han-hsiang. Sebuah film komedi seputar peristiwa-peristiwa menjelang pernikahan putri sang perdana menteri.

programme.title: Rape Of The Sword
programme.desc: Li Li-hua berperan sebagai seorang wanita pendekar pedang yang berusaha untuk merebut kembali 'Pedang Hijau', pedang paling tajam di dunia, milik suaminya yang tewas dibunuh.

programme.title: Love With The Perfect Stranger
programme.desc: Setelah putus dengan pacarnya, seorang wiraniaga Bao bertemu dengan seorang gadis kaya, Jin Jin, yang juga baru putus dengan kekasihnya. Dua orang asing yang patah hati ini pun langsung jatuh cinta dan menikah.

programme.title: The Swift Knight
programme.desc: Sang Pendekar Tangkas terlibat dalam jalinan percintaan, intrik kekuasaan, dan pertarungan sembari melindungi bayi pewaris takhta dalam kisah tentang para pendekar pemberani, keksatriaan, dan wanita-wanita cantik ini.

programme.title: Double Bliss
programme.desc: Ching Li berperan dalam kisah tentang dua pelajar yang berupaya membujuk orangtua mereka untuk merestui pernikahan mereka. Pasangan kekasih ini menjalankan sebuah rencana yang mereka kira mudah: berpura-pura mati!

programme.title: The Duel Of The Century
programme.desc: Seorang anak polisi bernama Kuo menyalahkan ayahnya atas kematian sang ibu. Ia menganggur dan menghabiskan waktunya di klub malam. Suatu malam, ia menyelamatkan Mei yang hampir dirudapaksa dan mereka menjadi teman.

programme.title: Forever Diamonds
programme.desc: Penipu cantik bernama Hua mencuri sebuah cincin berlian dari toko di Hong Kong dan kabur ke Singapura. Untuk menghindari bea cukai, ia memasukkan cincin itu ke dalam saku pria asing, tapi ia kehilangan jejaknya.

programme.title: The Convict Killer
programme.desc: Dalam film yang merangkai misteri dan ketegangan dengan aksi kung fu ini, seorang ahli kung fu membalas dendam setelah mendekam selama 15 tahun di penjara. Ia mampu bertahan menghadapi ujian di sepanjang hidupnya!

programme.title: The Pearl Phoenix
programme.desc: Dalam tradisi Opera Huangmei, film ini menceritakan kisah cinta Wen, yang menjual dirinya sebagai budak ke sebuah keluarga kaya, dan Huo, seorang putri muda dari keluarga itu.

programme.title: The Bells Of Death
programme.desc: Berkisah tentang perjalanan hidup seorang pria untuk belajar pedang, lalu melaksanakan balas dendamnya pada 3 pria yang telah membunuh keluarganya dan menculik adiknya.

programme.title: Sword Stained With Royal Blood
programme.desc: Diangkat dari novel karya Jin Yong, kekacauan terjadi ketika seorang prajurit yang tengah melarikan diri menemukan sebuah pedang, kitab sakti, peta harta karun dan sebuah pesan rahasia di atas jasad seorang guru.

programme.title: Reincarnated Swordsman
programme.desc: Fu membunuh kepala klan Wu Dang dan menjebak Yun sebagai pembunuhnya. Fu lalu menyatakan dirinya sebagai kepala klan baru dan memerintahkan untuk membunuh Yun, yang bersumpah untuk membalas kematian ayahnya.

programme.title: Mr. Funnybone Strikes Again
programme.desc: Big Potato membuka sebuah klinik Tiongkok kuno, namun metode tradisionalnya ditolak oleh masyarakat Hong Kong modern yang skeptis. Ia meminta sahabatnya, Mr. Funnybone, untuk membantu menyelamatkan kliniknya.

programme.title: Lady Of Steel
programme.desc: Ratu Kung-Fu asal Hong Kong, Cheng Pei-pei, berperan sebagai pendekar pedang wanita yang melakukan misi untuk membalas dendam atas kematian orangtuanya dan menyelamatkan negara dari penjajah asing.

programme.title: Madam White Snake
programme.desc: Linda Lin Dai memerankan tokoh Pak Su-cheng, dewi ular nan mempesona yang memilih wujud sebagai seorang wanita sehingga ia dapat merasakan indahnya kehidupan manusia!

programme.title: Twelve Deadly Coins
programme.desc: Qiao Miao hampir membunuh bandit yang baru saja ia temui, tapi ia tertarik dengan kecantikannya dan dengan cepat keduanya jatuh cinta. Kemudian, mereka terlibat dalam perseteruan antara pemilik senjata nan unik.

programme.title: Love Parade
programme.desc: Perancang busana Shi tidak terima dengan kritik Mui kala memintanya untuk mengomentari desain barunya. Saat Mui memintanya untuk merancang gaun untuk menghadiri pesta, Shi membalas dendam dengan membuat kostum badut.

programme.title: The Swordmates
programme.desc: Li meminta Wang, rekannya yang terpercaya untuk melindungi keluarganya saat ia pergi. Namun Wang memperkosa istrinya, membunuh pelayannya dan menyerang rombongan Li. Li khawatir jika putrinya masih berada dalam bahaya!

programme.title: Moonlight Serenade
programme.desc: Dalam drama yang mengerikan ini, aktris populer Shaw Brothers, Li Jing, berperan sebagai putri pemilik penginapan di daerah pegunungan. Ia menyaksikan aksi pemerkosaan yang dilakukan oleh salah seorang penduduk.

programme.title: Killers Five
programme.desc: Seorang putri bangsawan diculik oleh bandit Golden Dragon Hill yang terkenal kejam. Seorang pendekar pedang bernama Yue Zhen Bei ditugaskan untuk menyelamatkannya, dan ia menghadapi banyak bahaya dalam perjalanannya.

programme.title: Dawn Will Come
programme.desc: Liang Cai memerkosa Qiu Rong dan berjanji akan menikahinya usai mendapat persetujuan orang tuanya. Namun, tak ada kabar lagi tentang pernikahan tersebut. Qiu pun mendesak Liang Cai saat menyadari bahwa dirinya hamil.

programme.title: Call To Arms
programme.desc: Kekaisaran Chin yang agresif dan berbahaya menaklukkan kerajaan Chao yang tangguh, sementara kekaisaran Wei kehabisan pahlawan-pahlawannya dan lumpuh dipimpin penguasa yang tidak tegas.

programme.title: Asia-Pol
programme.desc: Agen Asiapol Yang Ming Xuan melacak suatu paket emas ilegal yang dikirim untuk ketua geng bernama George Eaton. Ia juga meminta bantuan seorang wanita Tiongkok yang ingin membalaskan dendam saudarinya.

programme.title: The Three Smiles
programme.desc: Seorang pelajar berbakat, Bo Hu, tertarik dengan seorang pelayan nan cantik, Qiu Xiang. Agar dapat mendekatinya dan memenangkan cintanya, ia menyamar sebagai seorang pelayan untuk bekerja di rumah yang sama.

programme.title: The Love Eterne
programme.desc: Dalam drama peraih berbagai penghargaan arahan Li Han Hsiang ini, Betty Loh Ti berperan sebagai gadis cantik yang menyamar sebagai anak lelaki demi mendapatkan pendidikan yang terlarang bagi anak perempuan.

programme.title: The Magnificent Concubine
programme.desc: Kaisar tergila-gila pada Yang Gui Fei, selir kesayangannya, sehingga ia menyerahkan pemerintahan negara kepada Perdana Menteri. Namun, Perdana Menteri yang korup, membuat rakyat memberontak.

programme.title: Apartment For Ladies
programme.desc: Betty Ting Pei berperan sebagai seorang penyanyi Taiwan yang datang ke Hong Kong untuk mencari adiknya yang hilang. Ia hampir diperkosa oleh geng jalanan dan diselamatkan oleh seorang komposer tampan.

programme.title: Temple Of The Red Lotus
programme.desc: Seorang pemuda bepergian ke Lembah Naga untuk menemui sahabat masa kecil yang dijanjikan untuk menjadi calon istrinya. Sesampainya di sana, ia menyadari bahwa keluarga sang mempelai wanita menyembunyikan banyak hal.

programme.title: The Butterfly Chalice
programme.desc: Ahli film laga Chang Cheh menceritakan kisah tentang Chin Feng yang bertemu dengan gadis cantik bernama Ting Hung saat tengah melarikan diri, setelah ia tak sengaja membunuh seorang pengganggu yang sombong.

programme.title: A Place To Call Home
programme.desc: Saat mengetahui jika dirinya adalah anak adopsi, Li Ching pergi untuk mencari keluarganya. Ketika situasi yang dialaminya menjadi semakin memburuk, ia akhirnya menyadari bahwa rumah adalah tempat yang terbaik.

programme.title: The Pure And The Evil
programme.desc: Reuni dua teman SMA yang semula manis segera berubah menjadi mimpi buruk erotis yang mengerikan ketika Rose tertarik pada mantan teman sekelasnya, Fang, dan tunangan barunya!

programme.title: Disciples Of Shaolin

programme.title: Tom Kerridge Cooks...
programme.desc: Tom Kerridge is on the road in Central Italy meeting producers who are as obsessed with growing ingredients as he is about cooking them. In his bespoke, vintage food truck he gets stuck foraging truffles in Umbria before discovering how the Campanian Plain has been a hotbed of agricultural innovation for thousands of years, something he sees in today's precision herb farms. In a forest whose location is a closely-kept secret, he joins Alessandro and his dogs Moretta and Nena on the hunt for Black Gold! Tom cooks up a feast to say thank you - an indulgent, delicious truffle mac 'n' cheese. His journey then takes him to the ancient ruins of Paestum, a city born out of agricultural innovation, something the Campanian Plain is still at the cutting edge of today. He joins Guillermo to turn his hand to the carefully created lines of a precision farm that lead the way in the 21st century. After a hard day's work Tom cooks baked cod with parsley butter, gremolata and saffron rice to celebrate.

The luxurious furnishings speak for danger. We'll find out. (Station info).

programme.title: Mission Mobility

programme.title: Car History
programme.sub-title: Auto Union – The story of the four rings
